turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
To use your new jewelry properly from day one, follow these simple steps:

Apply first and wear last: Put on your lotions, perfumes, and cosmetics before putting on your jewelry to protect the finish.
Wipe gently: After wearing, use a soft buffing cloth to wipe away any oils or residue.
Store properly: Keep your pieces in a clean, dry place like their original pouch when you are not wearing them.
